history.value: Spark Capital was founded in Boston in 2005 by Todd Dagres, Santo Politi, Paul Conway and Bijan Sabet, with a $265M first fund. It was an early backer of Twitter, Tumblr, Oculus, Wayfair, Slack and Plaid, and led Anthropic's Series C in 2023. In 2026 it closed a $1B early-stage fund and a $2.3B growth fund.
history.basis: Wikipedia (founders, fund sizes 2005-2024, Oculus sale, Anthropic Series C); the firm's Medium posts on the 2022 and 2024 funds; Form D filings for III, IV, Growth I-III, VI, IX and Growth VI (sources/edgar/fund-formds.json); ADV Section 7.B for the $15.6B gross asset value; entry stages from this run's base (Twitter Series A 2008, Plaid seed 2013, Cruise Series A 2015, Anthropic Growth 2023) Rewritten to the reader-facing shape (PRO-147, 2026-09-24). The Start@Spark seed program, the 2014 growth launch and its later positions (Affirm, Coinbase, Discord, Marqeta, Snap, Kalshi), the offices and the $15.6B of gross assets are in the basis above.

investment_concept.value: “Spark Capital invests in products we love by creators we admire across all sectors and stages.”
investment_concept.basis: The firm's own statement, verbatim from its meta description; the homepage headline is 'what's with the dog?', read 2026-09-26; sentence case, straight quotes and a closing period are the only edits. PRO-147: the thesis is the firm's own crisp statement (Erik, 2026-09-26). Published inside quotation marks, as the firm's own words (Erik, 2026-09-26).

investment_range.basis: Form D round sizes on member companies (313 non-pooled rounds): 10th percentile ≈ $1,130,000, median ≈ $10,339,997; upper limit = Baseten's $1.1B Series F (June 2026, Form D $1,096,448,855 sold), the largest round on a member's filings that Spark joined; round sizes are the round, not Spark's check

notable_investments.basis: The five best known of the firm's own companies, most recognised first: the names a general reader would recognise first (PRO-152, Erik 2026-09-24). Each is tied to its portfolio row by `slugs`; names read as a reader knows them, without legal suffixes (COLLECTION.md §8). Previously listed (8): Twitter, Slack, Oculus, Discord, Coinbase, Anthropic, Affirm, Wayfair.

hq_location.basis: Principal office on the newest Form ADV: 200 Clarendon Street 59th Floor, Boston, MA (SPARK CAPITAL, CRD 161231, Annual Amendment filed 2026-03-27). The firm's site names no office in its served pages (3 checked), so the Form ADV stands. Rule (Erik 2026-09-24): the newest Form ADV principal office, unless the firm's own site disagrees, and then the site wins.
